Class ServiceProvider

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.service.ServiceProvider
public class ServiceProvider extends Object
Central service locator providing access to all KLibrary services.

The ServiceProvider is initialized once during plugin startup and serves as the single point of access for all service instances. It is passed to action/requirement factories and made available through the ExecutionContext.

Initialization:

ServiceProvider services = new ServiceProvider(plugin);
// Services are now accessible:
services.getMessageService().send(player, "<green>Hello!");
services.getEconomyService().deposit(player, 100.0);

External plugins using KLibrary as a dependency can obtain the ServiceProvider via KLibrary.getServiceProvider() and use it to access all services without direct coupling.
